items.briefing:
Cybercriminals are increasingly using AI to speed up attacks, but Australian organisations are still being caught out by basic security failures like weak passwords and unpatched systems. A reminder that sophisticated tools don't change the fundamentals — good cyber hygiene remains your strongest defence. Separately, users of AI platforms like Anthropic's Claude are being targeted by information-stealing malware that hijacks login sessions, meaning attackers can access your account without needing your password.

Scam activity continues to affect Australians, with Scamwatch remaining an important resource for reporting suspicious contact. **Practical tip:** If you use any AI tools for work, enable multi-factor authentication on those accounts today.
